name: Crucial Ballistix DRAM
description: Crucial Ballistix DDR4 RGB modules (8 LEDs each) on the chipset SMBus (AMD FCH PIIX4, Intel), adapted from OpenRGB's CrucialController (GPL-2.0-or-later). On Windows the bus is reached through the HueDeck I/O broker and the PawnIO driver. Modules: BL8G32C16U4WL (2x on the reference machine), untested. SPD addresses are never touched; the controller has no save register. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/crucial-ballistix.md.
